_meta.window_rule: the window is defined by the capture, never re-derived here: 2026-11-16=8, 2026-11-17=5, 2026-11-18=12 games

empirical_dispersion.caveat: n=28 (26 for totals). Small sample; directional, not final. Corpus: data/played_games_2026_11_11_12.json + data/played_games_2026_11_13_14.json.

flags.item: Repeated matchups printed by the official schedule: POR@MIN on both 11/16 and 11/17, NYK@TOR on both 11/15 and 11/17 (same venues).
flags.detail: Rows transcribed from the official schedule with distinct game IDs (verified in the per-game link URLs on 2026-11-15); carried as printed and flagged for manual confirmation.

flags.item: No home-court advantage in any line.
flags.detail: HCA could not be sourced from an official NBA page; home moneylines are understated by exactly the real HCA. (Build B's measured home-win-rate 57.6% note remains a published finding, not applied.)

flags.item: Inputs dated, disclosed: ratings re-cut from the official captures retrieved 2026-11-16T14:43Z..15:02Z; records captured 2026-11-15; injury edition 2026-11-16_0930AM_acc2fd9e (revision 11/16/2026 09:30 AM ET (printed on the PDF as 'Injury Report: 11/16/26 09:30 AM')).
flags.detail: Every pick built on these lines is labelled MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED and stamped with this as-of date. Records go stale as earlier games in the window complete (rolling refresh job).

flags.item: The newest stored edition (2026-11-16_0930AM_acc2fd9e, revision 11/16/2026 09:30 AM ET (printed on the PDF as 'Injury Report: 11/16/26 09:30 AM')) covers 11/16/2026, 11/17/2026 only; later days in the window have no rows, and some blocks are printed NOT YET SUBMITTED.
flags.detail: Teams must file by 5 p.m. local the day before a game (1 p.m. local for the second night of a back-to-back), so blocks for the later days of the window cannot exist yet. Game-day editions appear 11 a.m.–1 p.m. local per league policy.

flags.item: Some team blocks in the 2026-11-16_0930AM_acc2fd9e edition are printed NOT YET SUBMITTED, and some clubs have no block at all.
flags.detail: The league prints a NOT YET SUBMITTED placeholder for a club that has not filed; an absent block is recorded as absent and never read as 'no injuries'. Both states are published verbatim.

flags.item: 0 injury rows lost their Team cell to PDF merged cells; team_effective inherits the nearest printed team.
flags.detail: Rows are marked team_inherited in data/official/injury_2026-11-16_0930AM_acc2fd9e.json and are published with that caveat. No line moves: no absence classifies as NEW_ABSENCE from evidence in this repo (canonical rule, scripts/injury_impact.py) -> adjustment 0.

flags.item: No market prices exist anywhere on this page.
flags.detail: No sportsbook feed is reachable or claimed; every probability is model-internal. Market-comparison gates (G4/G5) stay blocked.

flags.item: No strategy has passed the validation gates (Build A 0/8, Build B 0/10).
flags.detail: Every pick is therefore MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED, unfunded, and capped at zero stake until a strategy passes the gates. Outcomes: data/derived/strategies.json (Build A), docs/data/leaderboard.json (Build B) — internal artifacts, not official NBA sources.
